Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

```
import os,glob,re
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

from collections import deque, Counter
import itertools
demos_data=[(D1in,D1out),(D2in,D2out),(D3in,D3out),(D4in,D4out)]

def flood(g, start_cells, passable):
    seen=set(start_cells); q=deque(start_cells)
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<7 and 0<=nc<7 and (nr,nc) not in seen and passable(g[nr][nc]):
                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
    return seen

parts={'331':[(slice(0,3),slice(0,3)),(slice(0,3),slice(3,6)),(slice(0,3),slice(6,7)),
            (slice(3,6),slice(0,3)),(slice(3,6),slice(3,6)),(slice(3,6),slice(6,7)),
            (slice(6,7),slice(0,3)),(slice(6,7),slice(3,6)),(slice(6,7),slice(6,7))]}

def coarse_map(cells, part):
    out=[[0]*3 for _ in range(3)]
    for bi,(rs,cs) in enumerate(part):
        i,j=divmod(bi,3)
        if any((r,c) in cells for r in range(rs.start,rs.stop) for c in range(cs.start,cs.stop)):
            out[i][j]=1
    return out

def zeros(g): return [(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if g[r][c]==0]
def ones(g): return [(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if g[r][c]==1]
def zerosones(g): return [(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if g[r][c] in (0,1)]

for name, seedf, passf in [
    ('0-from(0,0)',lambda g:[(0,0)] if g[0][0]==0 else [],lambda v:v==0),
    ('0+1-from(0,0)',lambda g:[(0,0)],lambda v:v in (0,1)),
    ('1-from(0,0)',lambda g:[(0,0)] if g[0][0]==1 else [],lambda v:v==1),
    ('0-from-all-edges-0s',lambda g:[(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if g[r][c]==0 and (r in(0,6) or c in(0,6))],lambda v:v==0),
    ('0+1-edges',lambda g:[(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if g[r][c] in(0,1) and (r in(0,6) or c in(0,6))],lambda v:v in(0,1)),
]:
    ok=True
    for g,o in demos_data:
        f=flood(g,seedf(g),passf)
        m=coarse_map(f,parts['331'])
        exp=[[1 if v==8 else 0 for v in row] for row in o]
        if m!=exp: ok=False; break
    print(name, ok)

X=[];Y=[]
for g,o in demos_data:
    for bi in range(9):
        cells=block_cells(parts[(3,3,1)],bi)
        cnt=[sum(1 for r,c in cells if g[r][c]==v) for v in range(10)]
        X.append(cnt+[len(cells)]); Y.append(1 if o[bi//3][bi%3]==8 else 0)
# perceptron with bias
def perceptron(X,Y,epochs=5000):
    w=[0.0]*len(X[0]); b=0.0
    for e in range(epochs):
        err=False
        for x,y in zip(X,Y):
            a=sum(wi*xi for wi,xi in zip(w,x))+b
            if (a>0)!=(y==1):
                err=True
                s=1 if y==1 else -1
                w=[wi+s*xi for wi,xi in zip(w,x)]; b+=s
        if not err: return w,b,e
    return None
r=perceptron(X,Y)
print(r)

print(sum(Y), len(Y))
